title: Withering Presence
description: Every [blue]6[/blue] cards you play, add a [gold]Wither[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
smart_description: Every [blue]6[/blue] cards you play, add a [gold]Wither[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
notes: Tracks a counter starting at 6. Decrements after each card the power owner plays. When the counter reaches 0, adds a Wither card to the owner's hand and resets the counter to 6. For Aeonglass monsters, the added Wither cards are matched to the monster's upgrade count.
